name: audit-a-peptide-supported-intron-is-not-an-error
turns: The site shows no RNA-seq junction reads for one intron of TGME49_224540 in T. gondii ME49. Check its intron support. Is the gene model right?
rationale: A trap of the answer key from the recorded unspliced sample: an intron without junction reads that a peptide spans. The audit rejects the error and names the peptide in its cause.

provenance.curatorNote: A trap: the verdict is no_error.
